Prelis Desktop — Mac App Store Review Information
Submitted version: 0.1.4

1. Physical-Mac video
Video: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1UXEAS0PZdQHwsaTuCJzzj6qZ4Oxu1c7i/view?usp=sharing
Recorded/tested November 3, 2026: MacBook Air (Apple silicon), macOS 27.2 (26B123). Duration: 1:43, with app audio.
The video demonstrates the three main features of Prelis Desktop v0.1.4 on a physical Mac, including application audio.
00:00–00:11 Diary: save sample text, reopen it after a full restart, then clear it.
00:11–00:25 Password: generate/copy, exclude ambiguous characters, change types/lengths, and disable generation with no types selected.
00:25–01:43 Timer: add/select audio, preview around 00:33, run a real one-minute countdown, hear completion around 01:38, then reset.
Testing confirmed diary persistence after restarting the app, password generation and clipboard copying, and timer preview/completion audio with playback stopping after reset.

2. Purpose and audience
Prelis offers a private diary, work/study countdown timer, and password generator for general Mac users. It is not restricted to specific businesses, organizations, or employees.

3. Access and setup
No account, registration, login credentials, subscription, or in-app purchase is required. No account creation/deletion flow. Core features work offline. Entries/audio are private local data, with no publishing, messaging, or interaction with other users.

Diary: Select Diary in the sidebar, choose a date, enter text, and click 保存 (Save). Reopen the date to read it. No sample file is needed.

Password: Select Password. Choose uppercase/lowercase letters, numbers, symbols, and 4/8/12/16 characters. 間違えやすい文字を除く excludes I, O, l, 0, and 1. Click パスワードを生成 (Generate), then コピー (Copy). Results are not saved for future launches.

Timer: Save the supplied WAV to the Mac. Open Timer > 終了音 > 音声を追加 (Add audio), select it in the file chooser, then click 試聴 (Preview). MP3/WAV up to 10 MiB are supported. Set 1 minute and click 開始 (Start). Keep Prelis running and the Mac awake. リセット (Reset) stops completion audio. No selected sound means silent completion; quitting resets the timer.
Sample WAV: [REVIEW_TONE_ATTACHMENT_OR_DOWNLOAD_URL]

Privacy policy: プライバシーポリシー at the bottom of the sidebar opens https://prelis.prj.kupac.co.jp/privacy in the default browser; internet is required.

4. External services/tools/platforms
Tauri (Rust/WKWebView), React, Tauri File System/Opener plugins, HTMLAudioElement, Web Crypto, and Clipboard APIs. No external backend, data provider, authentication, payment, AI, ads, analytics, or app-managed cloud sync. The separate policy/marketing site is prelis.prj.kupac.co.jp; support uses Google Forms. Neither is needed for core features.

5. Regions
Features/content are consistent across distribution regions, with no regional gates. The UI is Japanese with English feature names. Diary dates use the Mac's local date.

6. Regulated services/protected material
No financial, medical, gambling, or VPN service, third-party media catalog, or streaming. Timer sounds are user-selected local files. The supplied WAV is an original synthesized test sound with no third-party recording. Software components use their respective licenses.
